issues.issue: Noncurrent compensated absences put in 'other liabilities' while the current portion is 'accrued liabilities'. Defensible, but it could also go in accrued liabilities or long-term debt. Label suffixes '(current)'/'(noncurrent)' on this and the restricted cash lines are not printed; they come from the section headings.

issues.issue: Nonoperating loss on disposition recorded as signed other_financing rather than a negative 'sale of assets' receipt. This is an assumption by the extractor. Amount and roll-forward are correct (675,609.55 + 722,045.12 - 633,452.01 - 19.72 = 764,182.94).
